title: Duplicate charge
body: When a customer was charged twice for one order, confirm both amounts on the order before reversing the extra charge.

title: Shipment not moved: tracking stuck at label created
body: If tracking has said label created for several days, check the shipment status before promising a new delivery date.

title: Damaged item refund
body: A damaged item can be refunded to the original payment method after the order is confirmed.

title: Cannot log in
body: If the password is rejected after a reset, verify the account email before sending another reset.

title: App crashes on launch
body: When the iOS app crashes on launch after an update, record the app version and phone model.

title: Change account email
body: An account email change must match the login email on the account before it is updated.

title: Gift wrap in stores
body: Stores offer gift wrap. The company was founded in 2014.
